text: もっと　もっと　おおきい　ヘラクロスが　みたいわー　すき　すき　でっかい　ヘラクロスー

structure.jp: もっと　もっと　おおきい　ヘラクロスが　みたいわー
structure.en: I want to see a much, much bigger Heracross

structure.jp: でっかい　ヘラクロスー

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on a verb says you want to do it, and the wanted thing often takes が. みたいわー = 'I want to see it!'

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end is a soft, womanly way to voice a feeling. みたいわー = 'oh, I want to see it'.
